<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Given that the input MI is before a partial terminator sequence TSeq, return true if M + TSeq also a partial terminator sequence.</p>


<p>A Terminator sequence is a sequence of MachineInstrs which at this point in lowering copy vregs into physical registers, which are then passed into terminator instructors so we can satisfy ABI constraints. A partial terminator sequence is an improper subset of a terminator sequence (i.e. it may be the whole terminator sequence).</p>


<p>Definition at line 53 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/codegen/codegencommonisel-cpp">CodeGenCommonISel.cpp</a>.</p>
